task_kind: Bounded follow-up diagnosis, not an independent review or revised acceptance run.
finding: Matched Windows failure demonstrates post-start replacement, so the probe pre-start cancellation assumption is false for that trace. No product defect is established by this diagnosis.

original_acceptance.original_exact_interleaving: No startup trace was enabled in the original run. This diagnosis proves causality for a matched reproduction, not a retrospective timestamp for the original sends.

workflow.feedback_loop: Original frozen discovery_recovery.exe startup <NEW_DIR> 25090 25094 already went red with the exact three checks in the previous task. The two follow-up diagnostic startup runs retain all original assertions/waits/workload.
workflow.scope_exceptions: No stress loop or iterative minimization: user limited diagnosis to at most two ordinary API runs. No Phase 5 product fix or acceptance rewrite was authorized; original failure remains failed.
ranked_hypotheses_before_runs: Post-start cancellation: initial startup send succeeds and commits before caller drop; caller can observe old closure before drop or a SearchStarted event on the new standard receiver.
Replacement wrongly commits after receiver dropped before startup: both relevant initial sends would report Disconnected yet the old identity/state would still be lost.
Old same-type retransmission removes new generation: loss would follow an old repeating command despite the same_channel guard.
workflow.instrumentation: Standalone diagnostic-only copies of the original example plus log::Log and ordinary caller observations. No product/vendor source was instrumented or changed.
workflow.run1_observer: Immediate stderr output; includes guard and 32 cancelled-type existing trace sites.
workflow.run2_observer: Buffer records in memory and write them after run completion; guard-only existing trace output. No sleep, pacing, workload or assertion change. Observer differences are explicit and are not acceptance evidence.
workflow.new_public_api_observation: Standard receiver try_recv before its drop; LimitedBrowse old/new is_closed observations before and after drop. Dirty snapshots or is_closed=false alone were not treated as startup acknowledgement.

frozen_inputs.file_manifest_copy_transform: CRLF to LF only; JSON entries unchanged.
frozen_inputs.old_fixture_access: Read-only; no files or attributes in old fixture were written.

compile_start.old_fixture_access: read only; attributes and evidence hashes recorded, not changed

causality.run1: Both target caller drops completed before their worker command entries. Existing failure logs confirm both initial SearchStarted sends returned Disconnected. Gauge stayed 1 and the original live view received later updates. All 32 distinct types also logged initial-send failures.
causality.run2_limited: Worker entered the non-repeating limited replacement at 9187738400 ns. At 9187936900 ns the caller recorded old live_closed=true while holding the new receiver. It dropped the new receiver only afterward. The source removes the old subscription only after initial try_send succeeds. Thus commit/success precedes this observed drop; no dirty-snapshot or new is_closed=false inference is needed.
causality.run2_standard: At 9188165800 ns the caller recorded first_event=Ok(SearchStarted(...)) on the new standard receiver, then dropped it at 9188170000 ns. This directly proves the initial event was accepted and received before drop.
causality.run2_cleanup: The next guard repeating-command entry is 9241744300 ns, after old-view loss and both drops. Normal disconnect cleanup permits eventual gauge 0. This trace does not show old-generation cleanup causing the earlier loss.
causality.run2_gauge: before=1 after_barrier=6 after_settle=0 live_closed=true. The temporary 6 is retained as observed. It is not labelled 32 orphan states; no state persisted after settle.
causality.matched_failure: All three failed check names match the original Windows 11/14 failure. Intermediate metrics differ and are preserved.
causality.hypothesis_result: Post-start scheduling is demonstrated for the matched reproduction. Both-initial-sends-Disconnected-then-old-view-loss was not observed. No product bug established.
causality.unobservable_boundary: LimitedBrowse exposes no SearchStarted receiver or direct startup/commit outcome. Source plus observed old closure proves the limited replacement committed before drop in run2; its exact try_send timestamp is not directly logged. Original send outcomes cannot be recovered retrospectively.

proposed_observation_only_next_step.smallest_change: If more exact send timestamps are required, add a diagnostic-only trace immediately at the existing initial try_send result, before any map mutation. Record service type, limited/standard kind, per-request/channel identity, actual Ok/Disconnected result and monotonic time. Correlate with caller drop boundaries. No worker rendezvous, pause, injected command or scheduling control.
proposed_observation_only_next_step.strict_classification: Only an actual Disconnected initial-send result establishes pre-start cancellation. An Ok result or received SearchStarted establishes post-start. Pending/unobserved or unmatched results mean unverified coverage, never PASS.
proposed_observation_only_next_step.pre_start_contract: For actual failed target sends, retain exact old identity, gauge=1, later old-view live update and no cancelled map state. Any lost old identity or persistent extra state remains red.
proposed_observation_only_next_step.post_start_contract: In a separately assigned positive-start case, keep the new receiver alive until startup/resolution is observed; require old closed, new live and fresh, and the exact one-state gauge. After dropping the new receiver, require cleanup to zero and no old-generation removal of a newer live subscription.
